terrain_source: 서울시 등고선.zip, 2025-03 processing history from source .shp.xml
comparison_archive: 서울시 경사도.zip, 2022-06 processing history; not used in elevation surface
spatial_reference: EPSG:5174 for terrain processing, EPSG:4326 for GeoJSON output
data_caveats: No surveyed sidewalk grade; interpolation over historical contours and spot heights.
Ground terrain is not the traveling surface for overpasses, footbridges, tunnels, and indoor links.
Cross-validation reflects elevation error at withheld spot heights, not direct slope accuracy.
Maximum grade refers to approx 15m sampling windows and may be noisy.
Do not call this wheelchair-accessible without step/width/curb/ramp data.
Do not promise shortest or safe routes until integrated and validated in app.
